title: Reducing and Classifying Fiber Bundles over Small Categories
summary: A fiber bundle over a small category is a locally constant family of categories whose transition functors encode how a fixed fiber is transported over the base. Its Grothendieck construction assembles this data into a category over the base, while its global behavior is governed by monodromy. For finite acyclic categories, relative beat objects provide reductions of the total category over the fixed base, leading to relative cores that exist and are unique up to isomorphism.
